sentence: This project builds a tool that uses deep learning to compare radiologic and pathologic images of tissue.
This project studies how to build navigation for autonomous systems that keeps working under cyber threats and jamming.
This project builds surgical robots that work on soft tissue with more autonomy by tracking tissue and predicting its deformation.
This project tries to make Sphagnum moss a lab model by growing it in the lab and building genetic tools and reference genomes.
This project builds tools for training machine learning models across many organizations while keeping private data secure.
This project builds methods to detect more metabolites directly in tissue by running chemical reactions on tissue sections before mass spectrometry imaging.
This project studies how montane ecosystems respond to a winter with record warm temperatures and very little snowpack.
This project uses scanning transmission electron microscopy to map temperature across interfaces between materials and to study heat flow.
This project tries to find the genes and proteins that let Leptothrix bacteria carry out iron oxidation.
This project measures halocyclopentadienes in drinking water, studies how they form and tests whether they could cause cancer.
This project uses computer simulations and theory to link the microscopic dynamics of constantly rebuilt fiber networks to how they respond at larger scales.
This project uses machine learning to find compact equations that describe how large-scale failure of brittle materials grows out of small-scale randomness.
This project uses microwave radiation to study how electrons act together in van der Waals materials at low temperatures and high magnetic fields.
This project tries to find out how a coastal crustacean keeps time with the tides and which genes control its circatidal clock.
This project studies how wetlands function and respond to threats such as land development and pollution.
This project studies molecular signaling, the process behind almost every cellular event.
